name: M7.GlobalQuery.strict_dominator
statement: ∀ (H N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : M7.DefaultQuery.Query) (bases : M7.GlobalQuery.Family H N) (x : M7.GlobalQuery.Index H N), M7.GlobalQuery.feasible q bases x → x ∉ M7.GlobalQuery.winners q bases → ∃ y ∈ M7.GlobalQuery.winners q bases, M7.Selection.better q.order (M7.GlobalQuery.objective q bases y) (M7.GlobalQuery.objective q bases x)
guidance: Instantiate Selection.selector_strict_dominator for the full finite product domain and literal DefaultQuery predicates. Pareto/lex order laws are already accepted. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve frozen target and default limits.
